summary: Adds a new skill for neonatal/pediatric panel harmonization, which differs from adult clinical panels by frequently targeting SI units (μmol/L, mmol/L, 10⁹/L, g/L, kPa) instead of US conventional units. Captures threshold-based detection rules, full-precision output requirements, and anti-patterns observed in the failed trace (scientific notation in CSV, header mismatches, incorrect lactate thresholds, and rounding).
